en-US.title: PortBridge · WebUI demo
en-US.signInHint: Demo password: PortBridge (case-sensitive). Do not enter a real administrator token.
en-US.sessionOnly: Public static demo, not a protected service. All data is simulated in this page; refresh to reset. Never enter real credentials or deployment information.
en-US.insecure: Public demonstration only. Never enter real credentials here.
en-US.dashboardHint: Simulated forwarding activity. No network traffic is forwarded.
en-US.accessHint: Try the settings locally. These controls cannot change GitHub Pages or any server.
en-US.demoNotice: DEMO · All rules, traffic and certificate details are synthetic. No real management API, DNS lookup or forwarding is used. Changes disappear on refresh; this public password is not access control.
en-US.trafficNotice: Simulated counters sampled about once per second; interface refreshes about every 500 ms. The production UI combines approximate cumulative Go/nft observations and displays rates separately. These are not benchmark results.
en-US.directPeer: Illustrative controls only; there is no server-side ACL on this public demo.
en-US.httpsHint: HTTPS protects delivery of this static site. The settings below are synthetic and do not configure its certificate or listener.
en-US.strictHint: This simulated allowlist cannot restrict access to GitHub Pages. The installed product enforces its own management ACL.
en-US.dnsHint: Formatting example only. No DNS requests are made and no resolver configuration is changed.
en-US.tlsHint: Example paths and certificate metadata only. Do not enter a real certificate, key, token or private server path.
en-US.networksHint: Documentation-reserved addresses, not detected network interfaces.
en-US.certificateOther: Synthetic certificate metadata, not the GitHub Pages certificate.
en-US.certificateSelf: Synthetic certificate metadata, not the GitHub Pages certificate.
en-US.rotateHint: Simulation only. The public demo password remains PortBridge.
en-US.confirmRotateBody: No real token is generated or revoked. The demo password stays PortBridge.
en-US.tokenRotated: Simulation complete; demo password remains PortBridge
en-US.confirmDeleteBody: Remove “{name}” from this page? No real forwarding is affected.
en-US.saved: Demo settings saved in page memory only.
en-US.savedRestart: Demo settings saved locally; no service restart or server change occurs.
en-US.invalidToken: Use the public demo password PortBridge (case-sensitive).
en-US.unauthorized: Use the public demo password PortBridge (case-sensitive).
en-US.demoInvalidRule: Enter a name, a valid protocol/data plane and equal port ranges (1–65535, at most 4096 ports).
en-US.demoInvalidSettings: Use port 1–65535, TLS 1.2/1.3 and certificate paths. Strict mode also requires a nonempty allowlist and automatic LAN disabled.
en-US.demoLimit: This demo allows up to 100 rules. Reset it to restore the examples.
en-US.demoInvalidRequest: Unsupported or invalid demo request. No network request was made.

zh-CN.title: PortBridge · WebUI 演示
zh-CN.signInHint: 演示密码：PortBridge（区分大小写）。请勿输入真实管理员令牌。
zh-CN.sessionOnly: 这是公开静态演示，不是受保护的管理服务。所有数据均在当前页面模拟，刷新即重置。请勿填写真实凭据或部署信息。
zh-CN.insecure: 仅供公开演示，请勿在此输入真实凭据。
zh-CN.dashboardHint: 模拟转发活动，不会转发任何真实网络流量。
zh-CN.accessHint: 在本页体验设置，不会修改 GitHub Pages 或任何服务器。
zh-CN.demoNotice: 演示模式 · 规则、流量和证书信息均为模拟数据，不调用真实管理 API、不解析域名、不转发流量。刷新后修改会丢失；公开演示密码不具备访问控制能力。
zh-CN.trafficNotice: 模拟计数约每秒采样，界面约每 500ms 刷新。正式版界面合并 Go/nft 近似累计观测值，实时速率分别显示；此处不是性能测试结果。
zh-CN.directPeer: 仅展示设置界面；此公开演示没有服务端 IP 白名单。
zh-CN.httpsHint: HTTPS 保护此静态站点的传输，下方模拟设置不会修改站点证书或监听地址。
zh-CN.strictHint: 模拟白名单不能限制 GitHub Pages 的访问。正式安装的产品会执行自己的管理 ACL。
zh-CN.dnsHint: 仅演示格式，不发起 DNS 请求，也不修改解析器配置。
zh-CN.tlsHint: 路径与证书信息均为示例，请勿输入真实证书、私钥、令牌或私有服务器路径。
zh-CN.networksHint: 使用文档保留地址，不检测真实网卡。
zh-CN.certificateOther: 模拟证书信息，并非 GitHub Pages 的实际证书。
zh-CN.certificateSelf: 模拟证书信息，并非 GitHub Pages 的实际证书。
zh-CN.rotateHint: 仅模拟操作，公开演示密码始终为 PortBridge。
zh-CN.confirmRotateBody: 不会生成或撤销真实令牌，演示密码仍为 PortBridge。
zh-CN.tokenRotated: 模拟完成，演示密码仍为 PortBridge
zh-CN.confirmDeleteBody: 从本页移除“{name}”？不会影响任何真实转发。
zh-CN.ruleCreated: 已在本页创建演示规则
zh-CN.ruleUpdated: 已在本页更新演示规则
zh-CN.ruleDeleted: 已在本页删除演示规则
zh-CN.saved: 模拟设置已保存，仅保留在本页内存。
zh-CN.savedRestart: 模拟设置已保存，不会重启服务或修改服务器。
zh-CN.invalidToken: 请输入公开演示密码 PortBridge（区分大小写）。
zh-CN.unauthorized: 请输入公开演示密码 PortBridge（区分大小写）。
zh-CN.demoInvalidRule: 请填写名称、有效协议/数据面及等长端口段（1–65535，最多 4096 个端口）。
zh-CN.demoInvalidSettings: 端口须为 1–65535，TLS 为 1.2/1.3，并填写证书路径；严格模式还要求非空白名单且关闭自动 LAN。
zh-CN.demoLimit: 演示最多允许 100 条规则，可通过重置恢复示例。
zh-CN.demoInvalidRequest: 演示请求不支持或格式无效，未发起网络请求。
